text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty: page fired for service=redwood-inference-prod latency-spike (PD_INC_87921). Routed to service 'platform-oncall' via schedule binding id=sb-4432. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD_INC_87921
maria: ugh, platform-oncall shouldn't be receiving inference-prod pages — that service is for infra alerts
sam: confirmed — i'm listed as inference-oncall but didn't get paged. platform folks are getting woken up.
alex: looks like a shadow schedule binding? last deploy touched schedule-syncer yesterday. paging rules maybe picked up legacy tag.
pagerbot: pagerduty: primary not acknowledged within 2m -> auto-escalated to escalation_policy=platform-leads.
jess: @ops-lead can we mute the alert while we sort routing? customers will still be impacted but avoids waking more teams.
ops-lead: we shouldn't fully mute until we know scope. quick mitigation: change PagerDuty routing key for this alert to inference-oncall manual reroute. I'll do a quick handoff.
sam: if we manual-reroute, please set a TTL for the override (15m) so we don't lose real infra pages.
oncall-rotation-bot: schedule sync job report: duplicate binding found for tag=service:inference-prod -> bindings: [sb-4432 (legacy-shadow), sb-9912 (active)]. Action: legacy binding flagged.
maria: there it is — legacy binding sb-4432 points to platform-oncall. who owns that?
alex: that binding was created in 2023 when we migrated teams; it was supposed to be removed. owner tag says @sam but timestamp is 2023-08-12.
ops-lead: i'm taking temporary ownership. Sam please ack that inference-oncall will accept pages for the next 15m override.
sam: ack, i'll take pages.
pagerbot: manual reroute executed by ops-lead: PD_INC_87921 now routed to inference-oncall. Notification: inference-oncall paged.
jess: customer impact check: errors spiking to 5xx for a subset of inference requests since 03:12 UTC, ~8% of traffic. front-end retries causing load.
maria: telling support to mark affected customers — possible degradation for embedding endpoints only.
alex: root cause for paging misroute: schedule-syncer code allowed duplicate bindings when shadow tags existed. quick patch: reject duplicate service tags. I'll open a PR.
ops-lead: remediation steps in-flight: 1) manual reroute (done), 2) remove legacy binding sb-4432 (do we have approval?), 3) patch syncer to dedupe, 4) retrospective.
sam: removing binding now would prevent future misroutes. i approve removal.
alex: prepping hotfix, will cut PR and request an expedited review. sample diff: ```diff
- allow_shadow_bindings = true
+ allow_shadow_bindings = false
``` 
pagerbot: PD:INC_87921 acknowledged by sam (inference-oncall) at 4332109888.
jess: can we get a short customer-facing blurb? support needs wording to send to affected customers.
maria: suggested blurb: "We experienced degraded latency on embedding endpoints between 03:12–03:30 UTC due to increased retries and a misrouted alerting workflow. The issue has been mitigated and routing fixed. Investigation underway; no data loss reported."
ops-lead: good. publish status page update and postmortem label: oncall-routing. Assign owners: alex (fix), jess (customer comms), sam (monitoring & verification).
alex: i'll land the patch and follow up in #eng-releases for backfill.
sam: monitoring shows traffic normalized by 03:28 UTC after the manual reroute and throttling tweak. will keep eyes on it for 2h.
maria: thanks all — leaving this thread open until postmortem created. :thumbsup:
